value.rationale: The joint formulas determine complete, naturally motivated rank-refined d-th-root counts for every idempotent and every positive d in an infinite family of inverse monoids. The independent ambient extension refinement measures a local-to-global symmetry obstruction, with a sharp exact rank-two multiplicity depending on unequal original part sizes. It quantifies classical homogeneity in a way that can be used for invariant computation and comparison; it is neither a single small parameter slice nor merely a restatement of the known yes/no boundary.
